item.title: Joe Budden Apologizes to Latto for Making It Seem Like She Doesn’t Write Her Own Raps: ‘I Wasn’t Tryna Play With Your Pen Like That’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. Joe Budden is making headlines after a recent episode of his podcast surfaced, where he apologized to rapper Latto. Let's dive into what happened."
[Short music transition]
Host: "It all started when Latto tweeted a photo of her handwritten lyrics to 'Hostage' from her new album 'Big Mama', and tagged Joe Budden after he compared her flow to Drake's. On his podcast, Joe explained that he wasn't trying to accuse Latto of not writing her own raps, but rather suggesting that she might be influenced by other artists, like Drake, when she writes her songs."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Joe said, 'being influenced by other rappers is something that can happen when you sit down to write your own songs.' He even shared his own experience of trying not to listen to the radio or other rappers when he used to write, to avoid being influenced. He apologized to Latto, saying 'Latto, I'm sorry. I wasn't tryna play with your pen like that. I get how it sounded like that, so my bad.'"
[Short music transition]
Host: "This isn't the only news surrounding Latto lately. Her new album 'Big Mama' just dropped, and she's been making waves with her track 'Gimme Dat', which appears to be a response to a leaked phone call with Cardi B back in 2025. Cardi has since apologized, but it's clear Latto is on a roll and not holding back."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's the latest on Joe Budden and Latto. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update."
